description: Shared GST calculation test vectors for shared/contracts/gst_rules.md. Both lib/services/gst/gst_calculator.dart (Dart) and salesforce/force-app/main/default/classes/GstCalculatorService.cls (Apex) must produce these exact outputs for these exact inputs. If you change either implementation's rounding/math, run both suites against this file before considering the change done — see root CLAUDE.md.
notes: 'total'/'grandTotal' and per-line cgst/sgst are rounded to 2 decimals only at the point calculateBill's final totals are produced — per-line values inside a bill are NOT individually rounded before summing, matching gst_calculator.dart's _round2 being applied only to the bill-level subtotal/cgst/sgst/grandTotal.
A bill's 'gst' field is cgst + sgst computed AFTER each is rounded (it's a getter on the already-rounded values), not the unrounded sum — vectors reflect that.

Dart doubles (IEEE-754 binary floating point) and Apex Decimal (base-10 exact arithmetic) can theoretically diverge by a cent on some fractional inputs that aren't exact in binary — vector 'fractional_paise_rounds_at_bill_level_only' deliberately exercises this boundary; if it ever needs a platform-specific tolerance, that's the vector to revisit first, not evidence the contract itself is wrong.
